optional_observations.note: Signed is inherited source terminology for original/hash-bound validation here. Current portable v4 uses SHA256-PAYLOAD-JSON local integrity, not a cryptographic origin guarantee against a same-user writer. Legacy Windows compatibility uses ECDsaCng, not RSA; it is neither selected new authority nor permission to create keys. Prefer one adjacent clarification; no proposal key/service implementation exists.

source_backed_assessment.assessment: GameEngine.MortalJointStoryTurn.cs:75–101 obtains the real canonical lease and applied phase, verifies projection/runtime, calls AppendMortalJointStoryAsync at86, then separately validates, increments and cleans. TurnLifecycle.cs:952/1040/1756/1831 gates these calls on no browser-staged action. SessionOperationContext.cs:192–310 separately retains established outcomes and finalization/close failure. The proposed receipt correctly leaves all of these parent obligations outside child completion.

StoryService.MortalJointRepair.cs:18–67 binds private issuer, exact owner/files/lease/applied object and exact current row/history. JointProgressionPhaseCapability in MortalQteDecisionPublication.MortalJointProgression.cs:23–95 validates real files/lease, current G and fresh phase proof. Its data or hashes cannot recreate it. Choosing a joinable same-process invocation is source-consistent only if original owner placement survives from birth; the design does not assert current hosting already does.

StoryService.MortalJointRepair.cs:75–112 appends once through AppendFileAtomicAsync after fresh source comparison, verifies exact after, mints and validates the real proof. Source reads :119–187 bind original Mortal context, current soul, narrative/output, conditional display roots, location, G and history. Prefix rules :190–242 preserve exact native bytes and use decoded-text history hashes; absence permits BOM+row+newline creation, while AlreadyAppended requires exact suffix and valid genuine prefix. The pure calculator uses the existing prepared timestamp, not a new clock/die. Story path helper branches are not independent realm eligibility.

The independently re-expanded Quartet/FootprintAdditional/item/resource/inactive-tail union plus pending-wound path is exactly42. Progression sources7, commands3, original QTE projection9, direct/conditional story3+3 and control/proof8 match the named source sets. Mandatory objects, conditional absent display inputs, exact source output/phase proof, original present/absent paths and dynamic history inventory retain distinct predicates. None becomes a mechanics/target write grant.

PendingTurnSnapshotReader.cs:193–211,303–375 validates authority and exact declared snapshot selection; PendingTurnSnapshotAuthority.cs:482–521,765–803,856–885 recomputes rollback map hashes with recorded modes. Dynamic original snapshot, rollback and history reads are bounded by admitted owner maps. A signed map value is not rollback permission, a universal exact-byte hash, or authority from a raw descriptor.

FileSystemManager.cs:916–955 dispatches the ordinary append; TrustedLocalStorage.cs:335–348 builds exact before/after and :181–247 publishes/retries. TrustedLocalFilePublication.cs:253–325 generates the real transaction ID, stages format1 intent, publishes one index0 member, commits before cleanup. Scratch names derive at:600–604. A new retry is a new transaction and must be registered while open; it is not cleanup of the previous one.

Progression phase reader:120–136 and ReadJointCompletedProofAsync:203–207 call ResolveBackupPublicationRecovery; BackupLifecycle.cs:31–46 can enter trusted-local recovery. Canonical acquisition FileSystemManager.cs:3850–3938 also recovers, as parent work. PublishLocalCore:203–207 can create the member directory, and native recovery can ensure its journal root. The proposal explicitly requires noncreating safe existing namespaces and idle evidence before child invocation plus exact-attempt interception afterward; this is a new adapter obligation, not a property current calls already enforce.

TrustedLocalFilePublication.cs:165–196 retains known commit despite cleanup failure; TrustedLocalStorage.cs:255–264 can return success after a cleanup warning. Thus semantic AppendedAndVerified is not sufficient native debt-free evidence. The proposal correctly keeps CommittedCleanupPending and native commit plus readback refusal distinct, pre-enrolls native/readback work, releases only the child borrow and joins outside new recovery locks. It never uses timeout or force-cancellation as completion.

Canonical and T197 plan/tasks additions accurately say UNACCEPTED/pending at the frozen carrier, one child only, hosting and parent enrollment open,16 future UNRUN checks. No child→parent close/turn/cleanup/HC promotion, native process launch, new key/OS service, source replay, new G, afterlife permission or target/newQTE activation is granted.

future_checks.title: Invoke-vs-seal race
future_checks.description: Seal on both sides of installing the child promise and before the async body returns its Task; no unregistered synchronous-prefix effect.

future_checks.title: Original object identity
future_checks.description: Different owner/files/lease/applied capability, copied descriptor or old G refuses; genuine in-process references work only while original host lives.

future_checks.title: Bridge loss hosting
future_checks.description: Kill frontend bridge while owner graph is in original keeper; real join continues. Kill actual owner process instead and require HOLD, never rehydration.

future_checks.title: Missing story
future_checks.description: Genuine absent original history creates precisely BOM+one frozen row+newline, not AlreadyAppended/no-change.

future_checks.title: Already appended
future_checks.description: Exact prior suffix/prefix/source proofs yields no native attempt; foreign suffix, extra turn, duplicate request/G or unlisted history refuses.

future_checks.title: Conditional inputs
future_checks.description: Each guardian/resident/NPC tag combination; absent optional roots vs malformed roots; frozen output/row unchanged across seal.

future_checks.title: Native phase cuts
future_checks.description: Before/after actual intent staging/publication, story stage/rename, commit stage/rename, each cleanup; exact one D1 outcome, no duplicate D5 settlement.

future_checks.title: Fresh retry suppression
future_checks.description: Transient rollback before seal may register next real attempt; after seal no new TransactionId or append even with identical bytes.

future_checks.title: Committed cleanup debt
future_checks.description: Native Committed plus cleanup failure remains tracked even if facade/story readback returns success; resolve exact original journal only.

future_checks.title: Readback refusal after commit
future_checks.description: Change a guard/source during readback; retain native commit and semantic refusal independently, no story rollback/replay.

future_checks.title: Hidden recovery and namespace effects
future_checks.description: Foreign journal at lease/proof boundaries, commit-stage-only evidence, missing stories/runtime parent: no unregistered recovery/creation; preserve parent debt.

future_checks.title: I/O/callback join
future_checks.description: Delayed async read/disposal, sync native error, hook spawned work, diagnostic outstanding I/O; no receipt before actual owned completion, timeout remains pending.

future_checks.description: Child success does not release lease/main pin; seal before parent return prevents turn increment/terminal cleanup; finalization/close failure retains child outcome.

future_checks.description: EOF latches uncertainty; actual empty+no exec required even for helper exit. Keeper death/reboot/new host/distinct root never yields original child or parent retirement.
